# B8 inventory: the free functions of `exe_bodies.h` / `*_funcs.h` (generated by `leftfree_a.py` at the kit commit)

One row per declaration acceptance.sh line 08 counts (412 at the kit). Columns: the declared name and where; the retail address on the declaration line (or the comment above it); Ghidra's name at that address (the exe is stripped: a `FUN_` / ad-hoc name, never a retail symbol -- the CLASS is read from the body: the first parameter is `this` when retail reads it in RCX as the object); the first parameter as declared; the TARGET class (LEFT_FREE.md's `member of X` column where it has one, else the first parameter's class); the kind from LEFT_FREE.md's reason column (`member` = becomes that class's member; `forwarder` = its callers call the target, the forwarder is deleted; `erased` = a type-erased core that becomes the class template's member (`Array<T>::Resize`, `Set<T>::Insert`, `ExternalPtr<T>::Serialize`); `free` = free in retail, STAYS and stays listed; `harness` = port-only, STAYS; `unclear` / `new (B7)` = the block reads retail and decides); the caller count outside the declaring header (definitions included: read the list); the block that owns it.

Blocks (B8_RULES.md §3): COMP-A, COMP-B (Component classes), GAME (Game classes), ENT (Entity / Dialog / Tutorial classes), RT (runtime/types classes and the template families), MISC (Player / Action / Work / Object classes, the `free` / `harness` rulings and the `void*`-first retypes), RES (the residue rows, no inventory rows).
